targets.grammar: Inference (the LIVE-tenant SPACE-GATE grammar the inference click target actually boots): the app has no list, no table, no canvas and no wizard — opening it renders one heading, "Please select a space", above one control, "Select a space…", with rows 0 and no space picked, so the GATE IS THE LANDING. Ported as the centrepiece: a header carrying the app name and a live space/invocation/plane count · the heading verbatim · the chooser as a typed absence · the estate's REAL space records beneath it, one row per live project record (name · project_id · custody posture · created stamp, cap 25 NAMED). Twenty-seven space-, invocation-, model- and adjacent planes are classified live into FOUR states (LIVE / EMPTY / REFUSED / NO READ ROUTE, the last decided from the daemon's own route index), each stamped with the HALF of the gate it answers for. JUNK EVIDENCE IS NAMED, NOT PORTED: the capture caught a PLATFORM news dialog ("What's new in Sensitive Data Scanner") floating over the app, its two controls, and a rail entry naming the LAST-VISITED application — all three are recorded in the control table with data-ioi-control-evidence="excluded_junk" so the exclusion can be checked rather than discovered as a silent omission; of the 12 recorded controls, nine are the vendor global rail, two are the dialog's and ONE is the app's. THE FINDING: A SELECTION THE ROUTE ACCEPTS IS STILL A GAP WHEN THE KEY IT FILTERS ON IS NEVER WRITTEN BY THE RECORDS IT IS MEANT TO SCOPE. Exactly two published reads in the whole daemon index accept a project filter, and the work ledger both accepts and APPLIES one — so every surface-level test for 'can this chooser be wired' says yes, including MS-1's. Of 7141 ledger entries, 60 carry the project_id the filter retains on and 542 name a model; the intersection is ZERO. The page ASKS the daemon rather than re-implementing its retain expression (SCH-1): three principled selections are put to the filter on every render — the first space the plane offers, the first space value the ledger's own rows carry that resolves to a real space, and the space key the inference lane itself writes — and at port time they answered 0, 34-of-which-0-name-a-model, and 0. The one plane carrying a space key (goal runs, 190 records, 348 declared invocation refs) pins project_ref to a single value resolving to NO space record. Three vocabularies, no intersection. The edge is checked from the other side too and re-derived every render: 0 of 11 space records carry an invocation field, 0 of their 25 refs names an invocation or model route, 0 of 3 project write routes would accept one, and 0 of the 47 readable model_invocation receipts and 0 of the 10 metered usage records carry a space field. The invoke verb accepts six body fields and none is a space. So the chooser is a typed absence naming the receiving route BY PATH and its predicate by its exact expression; the space records are rendered in full because it is the EDGE that is missing, not the spaces; and no second mutation spine is minted over the daemon's invoke route.
